start.description: Open a conversation, or continue a stored one when `resume` names it. Returns the session id; everything the session produces arrives on the topic model::session::<id>.

system.description: overrides the driver's configured system prompt for this session

resume.description: continue the stored conversation with this id instead of opening a new one

send.description: Send a message on a session. Returns as soon as the turn is accepted, not when it finishes: text, tool activity and the turn's ending arrive on the session topic, and exactly one terminal event (done, cancelled or failed) ends the turn.

cancel.description: Stop the turn running on a session. The session survives, rewound to before the abandoned message.

end.description: Close a session. Its transcript stays stored; `start` with `resume` brings it back.

sessions.description: List stored conversations, newest first: ids and small facts, never a transcript.
